cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Exactly as Planned
cards.instruction: Treat every exposed flaw, failed step, and unexpected consequence as proof that the scheme is unfolding by design.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mum found the surprise invitations. That puts us precisely on schedule.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I hid them in my sock drawer like you told me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Concealment and permanent loss are different things. You gave her something worth discovering. Well done.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's cancelling the caterer. Should I stop her?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. Confirm the cancellation for her. I won't have you undoing the control stage now it's working.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 calls discovery scheduled. A3 corrects B2's understanding of concealment and A5 corrects B4's proposed rescue into helping a supposed control phase.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 sock-drawer obedience prompts A3 to claim discovery was intended. B4 offers stopping cancellation, so A5 specifically tells B to confirm it instead.

relationship.evidence: B2 did what A asked and B4 offers useful intervention, making the helper plausibly concerned about a real party rather than merely exposing failure.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes B4's practical rescue attempt a threat to the claimed plan, deepening the insistence that cancellation is success.

specificity.evidence: A1 invitations, B2 sock drawer and B4 caterer cancellation give concrete event logistics.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's no/confirm instruction acts on B4's proposal; control-stage phrasing is A's justification to the helper, not a narrator summary.
